decks.notes: The key strategy of this Dimir Control deck is to maintain control of the game through disruption and card advantage. Utilizing powerful cards like Ancestral Recall, Time Walk, and Dig Through Time, the deck aims to answer threats efficiently with cards like Force of Will and Fatal Push while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Strip Mine and Wasteland. By leveraging card advantage and disruption, the deck can outvalue opponents and control the game until it can establish a winning position.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble powerful combo pieces such as Underworld Breach, Hullbreacher, and Bolas's Citadel to generate a massive advantage over the opponent. The deck includes various fast mana sources like Moxen and Lotus, along with powerful draw spells like Ancestral Recall and Brainstorm to dig through the deck efficiently. The deck also includes disruption in the form of counterspells like Force of Will and Pyroblast to protect its combo pieces, ensuring a quick and efficient win in Vintage 1 vs 1 games.

This deck focuses on generating mana quickly and efficiently to power out its combo pieces, specifically Coveted Jewel. It utilizes powerful artifacts like Black Lotus, Grim Monolith, and Mishra's Workshop to ramp up to its key cards. It also includes control elements like Force of Will and Sink into Stupor to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win condition. The strategy involves assembling the necessary pieces to generate a large amount of mana, drawing cards, and ultimately using Coveted Jewel's ability to gain a massive advantage and close out the game quickly.

This deck aims to quickly set up and execute the Doomsday combo, which involves stacking your library in a specific order to win the game on the spot. With cards like Dark Ritual, Demonic Tutor, and Doomsday itself, the deck can efficiently search for and cast the necessary pieces to achieve victory. The deck also includes disruption cards like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to protect the combo and interact with the opponent. By carefully managing resources and planning ahead, this deck can consistently pull off its game-winning combo.

The deck focuses on using powerful control tools such as Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Lavinia, Azorius Renegade to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage through card draw spells like Brainstorm and Dig Through Time. The inclusion of Mishra's Bauble and companions like Lurrus of the Dream-Den provide additional value and flexibility. The mana base is optimized for consistency and efficiency, allowing the deck to control the game and outpace opponents in a Vintage 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on using control elements such as countermagic, removal spells, and card draw to dominate the opponent's game plan. It also utilizes powerful mana acceleration from artifacts like Moxen and Black Lotus, as well as synergies with Mishra's Bauble and Lurrus of the Dream-Den. The deck aims to control the game early with disruptive spells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce, and then grind out victories with card advantage from Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time. Overall, the deck prioritizes disrupting the opponent's strategy while building up its own resources for a decisive win.

The main focus of this deck is to control the opponent's actions and resources through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures like Lavinia, Azorius Renegade. The deck also utilizes card draw spells like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time to maintain card advantage and find key pieces. The presence of Mishra's Bauble and Orcish Bowmasters suggests a focus on manipulating the opponent's deck and disrupting their game plan. Overall, the deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent while gradually building up its own advantage.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful control spells and disruptive creatures to outmaneuver and control the opponent. The key strategy involves using efficient counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce, removal spells like Swords to Plowshares, and card advantage engines like Dig Through Time and Treasure Cruise to maintain control of the game. Additionally, the inclusion of disruptive creatures like Lavinia, Azorius Renegade and Psychic Frog helps to disrupt the opponent's game plan and slow down aggressive strategies. The deck aims to efficiently control the game and grind out incremental advantages to secure victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing Coveted Jewel as a key piece in a combo strategy, supported by powerful artifacts like Grim Monolith and Paradoxical Outcome. The goal is to generate mana quickly with Mishra's Workshop and other mana rocks, allowing for explosive plays with cards like Tinker and Mystic Forge. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Trinisphere to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to assemble the combo pieces efficiently and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful synergy of artifacts and spells.

The deck revolves around utilizing combo pieces such as Underworld Breach and Hullbreacher to generate a strong advantage and win the game quickly. With powerful cards like Bolas's Citadel and Time Vault, along with the ability to protect your plays with cards like Force of Will and Pyroblast, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while establishing a dominant board presence. The combination of powerful tutors, fast mana acceleration, and card draw ensures that the deck can consistently assemble its key combo pieces and execute its game plan efficiently.

The deck focuses on deploying disruptive creatures early to slow down the opponent while ramping up with mana acceleration. It also includes hate cards like Chalice of the Void and Thalia to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures like Archon of Emeria and Luminarch Aspirant, while also having the ability to tutor for powerful equipment like Batterskull and Kaldra Compleat. The mana base is optimized for consistency and flexibility, with utility lands like Karakas and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's strategy.

This deck focuses on using disruptive spells like Force of Will and Force of Negation to protect its threats, while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Lavinia, Azorius Renegade and Hullbreacher. The deck aims to control the game with counterspells and removal, while making efficient use of card draw with Ponder and Brainstorm. The inclusion of cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Narset, Parter of Veils help to slow down the opponent's game plan, while cards like Swords to Plowshares provide necessary removal. The mana base is optimized for consistent access to both white and blue mana sources.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Dredge mechanic to quickly fill the graveyard with key creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By constantly dredging cards from the graveyard, the deck aims to bring back powerful creatures like Prized Amalgam and Shambling Shell, while also utilizing cards like Creeping Chill to deal damage to the opponent. With strong disruption like Force of Will and Grief, as well as recursion from cards like Noxious Revival, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with an aggressive combo strategy.

This deck revolves around assembling powerful artifacts such as Tinker, Time Vault, and Coveted Jewel to generate mana and draw cards quickly, eventually winning the game through a combo finish. The key strategy is to use cards like Phyrexian Metamorph and Voltaic Key to create infinite loops and generate a massive advantage over the opponent. With access to fast mana sources like Moxen and Mishra's Workshop, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its powerful synergies and win the game before the opponent can react effectively.

The main concept of this deck revolves around utilizing the powerful combo potential of Underworld Breach to recur key spells and generate explosive card advantage. By combining fast mana acceleration like Black Lotus and Moxen with card draw engines like Brainstorm and Ponder, the deck aims to quickly assemble a winning combination of cards such as Hullbreacher and Brain Freeze to either mill out the opponent or generate a significant advantage. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Pyroblast to protect its game plan and disrupt the opponent's strategy.

This deck revolves around utilizing Coveted Jewel to generate a large amount of mana and draw cards through the Paradoxical Outcome. It aims to find key pieces such as Time Vault and Manifold Key to take extra turns and eventually win the game. The deck also includes powerful artifacts like Black Lotus and Moxen to accelerate the game plan. With the help of cards like Force of Will to protect its combo pieces, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo and overwhelm the opponent with its powerful synergies.
